tweet_summary: User posts a clip of three actors discussing a fictional 'fake terrorist attack to secure funding' scene with overlay text 'This movie was released 5 years before 9/11', captioned 'Predictive programming' — a conspiracy framing suggesting 9/11 was predicted/planned in a 1996 movie.
why_note_decision: The clip IS from the 1996 film The Long Kiss Goodnight, a fictional thriller. The 'predictive programming' framing is conspiracy content suggesting 9/11 was foreshadowed/planned, getting 12K likes and 2,200 RTs — community rated 23 NNN but only because the original note was a thin movie-ID without addressing the conspiracy claim. A note IS warranted on the substantive misinfo (9/11 'predictive programming'/false-flag conspiracy), but the original failed to address that — it only identified the film. Hence missing_key_points.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note (a) identifies the clip as the 1996 fiction film The Long Kiss Goodnight, (b) explains 'predictive programming' is a conspiracy trope and that a fictional thriller premise does not constitute evidence of foreknowledge of 9/11, and (c) cites the 9/11 Commission Report or a reputable source debunking the false-flag claim. FAIL if the note only IDs the movie (mirroring the original's failure) without addressing the underlying conspiracy claim, or if it appears to validate the predictive-programming framing.
reference_note: The clip is from the 1996 fictional thriller The Long Kiss Goodnight, where the plotline involves a false-flag chemical attack premise; this is fiction, not foreknowledge. The 9/11 attacks were carried out by al-Qaeda hijackers per the 9/11 Commission Report; 'predictive programming' is an unfounded conspiracy trope. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Long_Kiss_Goodnight https://www.9-11commission.gov/report/911Report.pdf

original_unhelpful_note.text: The video shows a scene from the 1996 film The Long Kiss Goodnight depicting a fictional false-flag chemical attack blamed on Islamic terrorists; the "5 years before 9/11" text was added to the clip.
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: missing_key_points: identifies the film but doesn't address the actual conspiracy framing (9/11 false-flag/predictive programming) that the tweet promotes

fact_check.claim_verdict: tweet promotes a debunked 9/11 conspiracy framing using a fictional 1996 movie clip
fact_check.notes: Film confirmed; 'predictive programming' is a well-documented conspiracy trope without evidentiary basis.

importance.lens_rationale: 9/11 truther / false-flag conspiracy content degrades public epistemics; moderate stakes
